Lemma
[strict parabolicity of the DeTurck-modified flow] Source: cao-zhu 1. Lemma 1.2.1\group Cao–Zhu Short-time Existence and Uniqueness The DeTurck-modified flow is strictly parabolic.
Proof

\sketch Its principal part is $g^{kl}\partial _k\partial _lg_{ij}$, so its symbol at a nonzero covector $\zeta $ is $(g^{kl}\zeta _k\zeta _l)\widetilde g_{ij}$.

□
